Internet Backbone

What is Internet Backbone

The internet backbone is the core infrastructure that connects networks around the world, enabling the internet to function. It's made up of the largest and fastest networks, which are linked by fiber-optic cables and routers.

who is maintaining the Internet Backbone

The backbone is operated by commercial, educational, governmental, and military entities. Some examples of companies that operate the backbone include Sprint, UUNET, AT&T, GTE, and Nextel.
